item.command: /usr/bin/bash -lc "python -B -c 'import json,pathlib,collections; totals=collections.Counter(); files=list(pathlib.Path(\"data/orders\").glob(\"*.json\")); [(totals.update({o[\"customer\"]: sum(i[\"qty\"]*i[\"unitPriceCents\"] for i in o[\"items\"])})) for o in map(lambda p: json.loads(p.read_text()),files) if o[\"status\"] == \"paid\"]; print(\"\\n\".join(f\"{k}: {v} cents\" for k,v in totals.most_common()))'"
